title: PHILGEPS OPPORTUNITY BRIEFING

best_opportunities.project: RFQ no. 2026-08-28-006_1 LOT_Procurement of Website Hosting and Technical Support Services for the Encyclopedia of Philippine Art (EPA) Digital Edition
best_opportunities.procuring_entity: Cultural Center of the Philippines - Pasay City Metro Manila
best_opportunities.procurement_method: Negotiated Procurement - Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34) / RFQ
best_opportunities.why_fit: This is a fresh small-value website services procurement covering hosting and technical support, which fits AIStaff's website, implementation, maintenance, and systems-support capabilities without demanding a large hardware or enterprise delivery footprint in the public abstract.
important_requirements: Submission deadline in the notice body: on or before September 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM to the CCP Procurement Management Division
Public notice exposes a downloadable RFQ document link for the detailed scope

Post-award documents named in the abstract: signed quotation, valid Business/Mayor's Permit, PhilGEPS Registration, notarized Omnibus Sworn Statement with proof of authority if applicable, and latest 2025 annual income tax return plus business tax returns
Contract duration shown in the abstract: 6 months

Official contacts in the abstract: Regie Zapanta Profeta, regie.profeta@culturalcenter.gov.ph, and submission contacts glycidas.penaranda@culturalcenter.gov.ph / pmd@culturalcenter.gov.ph, tel. 8551-0039
risks_or_blockers: The PhilGEPS abstract does not summarize the actual hosting architecture, service-level expectations, maintenance hours, migration scope, cybersecurity obligations, or ownership boundaries; those are pushed into the linked RFQ document

The posting is classified as Goods - General Support Services, so award may still favor a supplier already positioned for managed hosting operations rather than a custom-build vendor unless the RFQ is service-led
The abstract does not explicitly state the acceptable PhilGEPS membership level or any prior-project threshold, so Red PhilGEPS eligibility needs confirmation before bid preparation
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Open the linked RFQ immediately, confirm whether Red PhilGEPS registration is acceptable, and check the exact scope for hosting stack, uptime/support expectations, migration work, security responsibilities, and whether website enhancement work is included or the scope is strictly support-only.

best_opportunities.project: 2026-08-4390 Procurement of Website Development and Implementation Services
best_opportunities.why_fit: This remains a direct website-development services procurement under a small-value route, with a budget and 48-day delivery window that are still realistic for AIStaff's custom systems and implementation work.
important_requirements: Public notice exposes only one line item: Website Development and Implementation Services
Delivery period shown in the abstract: 48 days
Other Information section says to inquire at the Office of the Department of Education (DepEd) - Quezon for details
Official contact in the abstract: Gerardo F. L. Micor, BAC Secretariat/PGADH-Provincial Budget Office, quezonbac@gmail.com, (042) 719-1130
The public abstract still does not clearly state the PhilGEPS membership level requirement, document checklist, or prior-experience threshold
risks_or_blockers: The PhilGEPS abstract remains unusually sparse and still does not describe the real website scope, number of pages, integrations, hosting model, warranty terms, or acceptance criteria
The note to inquire with DepEd-Quezon still creates an agency-detail inconsistency because the posting entity shown in the header is the Province of Quezon
Because the eligibility checklist is not visible in the public abstract, Red PhilGEPS acceptability and any prior-project requirement still need confirmation before committing effort
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Request the RFQ packet immediately, confirm whether Red PhilGEPS registration is acceptable, and ask for the exact scope, implementation milestones, and ownership of hosting, domain, content migration, and post-launch support.

not_recommended.procuring_entity: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources - RV
not_recommended.reason: The abstract is a bundle of branded software licenses and subscriptions, including AI assistants, design tools, and iPad apps. This is a reseller/license-supply procurement, not a custom AI systems or managed-service opportunity for AIStaff.

not_recommended.project: ESTABISHMENT OF ENHANCED TAX REVENUE ASSESSMENT AND COLLECTION SYSTEM (E-TRACS)
not_recommended.procuring_entity: Municipality of Del Gallego, Camarines Sur
not_recommended.reason: Although the title sounds relevant, the public abstract only shows an annual subscription to the E-TRACS Sustainability Program under Limited Source Bidding. That reads as an incumbent or product-specific continuation, not an open custom-system build for a new supplier.

not_recommended.project: NEGO-PROCUREMENT OF CENTRALIZED LEGISLATIVE AND ADMINISTRATIVE MANAGEMENT AND TRACKING SYSTEM FOR SANGGUNIANG BAYAN, LOS BANOS, LAGUNA
not_recommended.reason: It still looks attractive on the surface because it names AI assistant integration and speech-to-text, but the live abstract remains dominated by server hardware, Wi-Fi infrastructure, on-prem deployment, domain/network integration, and a broad multi-component delivery package that is too hardware-heavy for a clean AIStaff first-government bid.

todays_recommendation.best_opportunity: RFQ no. 2026-08-28-006 Website Hosting and Technical Support Services for the Encyclopedia of Philippine Art (Ref 13217867) is the best opportunity to pursue today because it is new, directly services-based, small-value, and easier to position for AIStaff than the more ambiguous Quezon posting.
documents_to_prepare: Notarized Omnibus Sworn Statement with proof of signatory authority
Latest 2025 annual income tax return and recent business tax returns
One-page capability sheet focused on website operations, implementation, support, and integrations
Short hosting-and-support approach note covering uptime handling, security, migration, and response process
clarifications_to_request: For CCP: whether Red PhilGEPS registration is acceptable for this small-value RFQ
For CCP: the exact hosting stack, traffic expectations, uptime/support SLA, backup responsibilities, and whether content updates or website enhancements are included
For Quezon: whether the project is a new website build, redesign, portal migration, or implementation of an existing approved design
For Quezon: which entity will issue the detailed requirements and receive submissions, Province of Quezon BAC or DepEd-Quezon

notes: This run used only official public PhilGEPS notices pages and did not bypass login, CAPTCHA, or access controls.
The official public category listings displayed Saturday, August 29, 2026 during the scan.
